page.content:
Old Kingdom capital and cult city of Ptah.

How Memphis connects

  • Creator: Ptah — Ptah is the creator-god of Memphis.
  • Location: Pyramids of Giza — The Giza pyramids belong to Memphis' Old Kingdom hinterland.

What is Memphis?

Memphis stood at the Nile's fork as the early dynastic capital. Its theology made Ptah the craftsman-creator; the pyramids of Giza rise just north of its hinterland.

Key threads lead to Ptah and Pyramids of Giza.
